plain_english: Great virgin goddess, with aiṁ, five, hūṁ, śrīṁ, vicce, the sandals, together with the root mantra, and a triple handful offering.
sanskrit_cite: aiṁ 5 hūṁ śrīṁ mahākomārikā vicce pādukāṃ mūlamantrana triyāñjali

plain_english: Auspicious great fierce goddess, the sandals, eight, aiṁ, five, to the buffalo seat, the sandals.
